jurisdictions.name: The Factories Act, 1948
jurisdictions.authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH), Maharashtra

clauses.heading: Notice of certain accidents

trigger.condition: injury prevents the person from working for 48 hours or more immediately following the accident, or death

obligation.form: notice as prescribed under state rules

clauses.text: Where in any factory an accident occurs which causes death, or which causes any bodily injury by reason of which the person injured is prevented from working for a period of forty-eight hours or more immediately following the accident, or which is of such nature as may be prescribed in this behalf, the manager of the factory shall send notice thereof to such authorities, and in such form and within such time, as may be prescribed.

clauses.heading: Notice of certain dangerous occurrences

trigger.condition: prescribed dangerous occurrence whether or not any bodily injury is caused

clauses.text: Where in a factory any dangerous occurrence of such nature as may be prescribed occurs, whether causing any bodily injury or disability or not, the manager of the factory shall send notice thereof to such authorities, and in such form and within such time, as may be prescribed.

clauses.heading: Notice of certain diseases

trigger.condition: worker contracts any disease specified in the Third Schedule

clauses.text: Where any worker in a factory contracts any disease specified in the Third Schedule, the manager of the factory shall send notice thereof to such authorities, and in such form and within such time, as may be prescribed. If any medical practitioner attends on a person who is or has been employed in a factory and who is suffering from any disease specified in the Third Schedule, the medical practitioner shall without delay send a report in writing to the office of the Chief Inspector.

clauses.heading: Notice of accident

trigger.condition: accident causing death or injury preventing work for 48 hours or more

clauses.text: Where any accident occurs in a factory which causes death, or which causes any bodily injury by reason of which the person injured is prevented from working for a period of forty-eight hours or more, the manager shall forthwith send notice thereof by telephone, special messenger or telegram to the Inspector and the Administrative Medical Officer, Employees' State Insurance Scheme, and shall also, within twelve hours of the occurrence, send a written report in Form 24 to the Inspector, the Administrative Medical Officer and the nearest police station (in case of a fatal accident).

clauses.heading: Notice of dangerous occurrence

trigger.condition: explosion, fire, collapse of building, bursting of plant, gassing, irrespective of injury

clauses.text: Where in a factory any of the following dangerous occurrences take place, namely explosion, fire, collapse of a building or part thereof, bursting of a plant used for containing or transmitting steam or other gas, or gassing, the manager shall send notice thereof in Form 24A to the Inspector within twelve hours of the occurrence, whether any bodily injury is caused or not.

jurisdictions.name: The Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996

clauses.heading: Notice of accidents

trigger.condition: accident causing death, or bodily injury preventing work for 48 hours or more

clauses.text: Where in any establishment an accident occurs which causes death or which causes any bodily injury by reason of which the person injured is prevented from working for a period of forty-eight hours or more immediately following the accident, or which is of such a nature as may be prescribed, the employer shall give notice thereof to such authorities, in such form and within such time as may be prescribed.

jurisdictions.name: Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Central Rules, 1998
jurisdictions.authority: Director General, Inspection / State BOCW Inspector

clauses.heading: Notice of accident

trigger.condition: fatal accident or accident causing disablement

obligation.notify: Inspector, Board, and (if fatal) the police

clauses.text: Where any accident at the construction site causes death or disablement of a building worker, the employer shall give notice thereof by telephone, fax or similar means to the Inspector and the Board, and in the case of a fatal accident also to the officer in charge of the nearest police station, and shall send a report of the accident in Form XIV to those authorities. For a fatal accident the written report shall be sent within four hours of the occurrence; for other reportable accidents the written report shall be sent as soon as practicable and in any case within seventy-two hours.

clauses.heading: Notification of occupational diseases

trigger.condition: building worker contracts a notifiable occupational disease

clauses.text: Where a building worker contracts any occupational disease specified in the Schedule, the employer shall send notice thereof to the Inspector and the Board in the prescribed form within forty-eight hours of the disease coming to his knowledge.

jurisdictions.name: Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948 / ESI (General) Regulations, 1950

clauses.heading: Accident report to ESIC

trigger.condition: employment injury to an insured person

clauses.text: Every employer shall send a report in Form 12 to the appropriate Branch Office in respect of any accident causing employment injury to an insured person, immediately, and in any case not later than forty-eight hours after the occurrence of the accident or after the accident comes to the notice of the employer. Where the injury results in death, the report shall be sent immediately.

clauses.heading: Report of fatal accidents and serious bodily injuries

trigger.condition: accident resulting in death or serious bodily injury

clauses.text: Where, by any law for the time being in force, notice is required to be given to any authority, by or on behalf of an employer, of any accident occurring on his premises which results in death or serious bodily injury, the person required to give the notice shall also send, within seven days of the death or serious bodily injury, a report to the Commissioner giving the circumstances attending the death or serious bodily injury.
